name: mts-cave-bridge
title: MTS Bridge for The Cave
author: bits-orio
description: Play The Cave with Multi-Team Support (MTS): every multiplayer team digs its own cave on its own map. Requires both mods. Main Trains, shelters and interiors belong to the team that owns them, a defeat resets or disbands only the team that lost, and MTS pauses, staged starts and spectators work underground.
